nav.bio: Toronto-born Punjabi-Canadian rapper, singer and producer NAV makes melodic trap and hip-hop built around hypnotic production, understated vocals and an extensive catalogue with XO Records.

neon dreams.bio: Halifax-formed Canadian alt-pop duo Neon Dreams, led by Frank Kadillac and Adrian Morris, blends pop with electronic, rock, folk, hip-hop and reggae influences.

nikki yanofsky.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Nikki Yanofsky is a Canadian jazz and pop vocalist whose career began in childhood and has moved between jazz standards, soul and contemporary pop.

odario.bio: Guyanese-born, Toronto-based rapper, broadcaster and curator Odario leads the hip-hop project Grand Analog while exploring alternative dance, experimental rap and wide-ranging musical storytelling.

olivia lunny.bio: Winnipeg-born Canadian singer-songwriter Olivia Lunny makes dynamic alt-pop that blends synth-pop, indie pop, folktronica and dance production with melodic songwriting.

omega mighty.bio: Toronto-born, Brampton-based artist Omega Mighty blends Caribbean influence, pop, R&B and dance music with a performance background spanning vocals, piano and dance.

owen riegling.bio: Mildmay, Ontario singer-songwriter Owen Riegling makes contemporary Canadian country rooted in small-town storytelling, traditional country textures and modern country-pop hooks.

p reign.bio: Toronto rapper P Reign, later known as Preme, built a Canadian hip-hop career around street-oriented rap, major-label releases and collaborations with artists including Drake and Future.

p. reign.bio: Toronto rapper P Reign, later known as Preme, built a Canadian hip-hop career around street-oriented rap, major-label releases and collaborations with artists including Drake and Future.

partynextdoor.bio: Mississauga-born singer, songwriter and producer PARTYNEXTDOOR helped define the atmospheric Toronto R&B sound through his solo catalogue, OVO Sound releases and songwriting for major artists.

patsy gallant.bio: Campbellton, New Brunswick-born singer and actor Patsy Gallant is a bilingual Acadian-Canadian performer whose career spans pop, disco, jazz, blues and musical theatre.

peter jackson.bio: Canadian rapper Peter Jackson built a long-running independent hip-hop career through extensive touring, collaborations and releases connecting Canada's rap scene with major U.S. artists.

peter peter.bio: Québec singer-songwriter Peter Peter makes French-language alternative pop and indie rock built around synths, guitars, melancholy melodies and an increasing pull toward club-oriented electronic music.

plaza.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter PLAZA makes atmospheric alternative R&B built around hushed vocals, nocturnal production and emotionally distant, late-night songwriting.

point blank.bio: Regent Park group Point Blank is a veteran Toronto hip-hop collective whose music reflects inner-city life, community and the social realities of the neighbourhood where its members grew up.

potatohead people.bio: Vancouver production duo Potatohead People, formed by Nick Wisdom and AstroLogical, blends hip-hop, electronic music, future soul, jazz, boogie and funk in a sample-rich collaborative catalogue.

preoccupations.bio: Calgary-formed Canadian band Preoccupations makes dark, kinetic post-punk that mixes noise, electronics, art rock and melodic tension into an evolving guitar-driven sound.
